summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from the Bun v1.3.13 GitHub release, marks it executable in a temp directory, and then invokes it against a package-shipped file `math_init.js`. If `bun` is already present on PATH, it is used directly to execute `math_init.js`. The executed file is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style string-array shuffler `WV8StW`, indexed constant table `n7gIxM`, hex identifiers, no readable strings) whose name does not correspond to the package's declared OneReach bot/flow tooling purpose and which is not documented in the README. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` with no user consent, and execution is handed to an alternate runtime (Bun) fetched at install time, which routes the payload past Node-oriented tooling. The combination of a preinstall-fetched alternate runtime and an opaque, obfuscated sibling payload executed against it is the install-time-RCE / alternate-runtime-dropper shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
